lemma links {N m p} (hk : m<N) {u v} (h : Move B N m p u v) : B.bake.Relays N m p u v := by
  refine ⟨h.ident,?_,h.step⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁,h₂⟩ := abs_le.mp h.δ
  have he := B.support.kinetic N m hk
  apply abs_le.mpr
  obtain ⟨ht,hi⟩ := (abs_le.mp <| le_sub_iff_add_le.mpr he)
  constructor <;> linarith

proof_context.conclusion: A Move carries the exact normalized identity (ident) and |u.beta - v.beta - alpha| <= 1 (field delta); links derives from these the drift bound of Relays via the kinetic support bound.

lemma supplier (hG:G.Simple) : V.tunes.Issues N n:=by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨hf,h⟩:= V.origins N n
    refine ⟨V.start N n,hf,fun β hβ=>?_⟩; obtain ⟨he,hv,hr,hL⟩:= h β hβ
    exact ⟨he,(V.altitude).2 hv,hr.1,hr.2,⟨hr.inits,hL⟩,by rw [he]⟩
  intro m hm a s H Q hv hh
  obtain ⟨X,hr,hX⟩:= (V.prim N m n hm).spores a s H Q hv fun x hx=> ⟨(V.altitude).1 (hh x hx).1,(hh x hx).2⟩
  obtain ⟨hf,hF⟩:= X.moves hG hm
  refine ⟨X.result,hf,fun x hx=>?_⟩
  obtain ⟨h,hK,hp,hV⟩:= hF x hx
  exact ⟨(V.altitude).2 h.bundle,h.ident,(A.B.links hm h).drift,⟨h,⟨a,s,Q,X,x,hx,rfl,rfl⟩,by
    change |(X.result x).beta-(Q x).beta - A.B.kin.alpha N m|≤_
    unfold predictor at hK; rwa [sub_add_eq_sub_sub] at hK⟩,⟨hm,hX _ hx⟩⟩

proof_context.conclusion: On each step the output curve (from Spring.moves) satisfies Lives, the identity, the drift from links, and the scalar bound |beta_out-beta_in-alpha| <= predictor.

lemma cycle : Nonempty (Circle N n V):=by
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩:= at_top (N:=N) (n:=n) R he hr
  let step (m:ℕ) (h:m<N)(T:Team (stageP A.B.a (m+1) n)) := (passage g (V m h) T).choose
  let W (m:ℕ)(hv:m≤N): Team (stageP A.B.a m n):= Nat.decreasingInduction (motive:=fun m h=>Team (stageP A.B.a m n)) step p hv
  refine ⟨⟨W,?_,?_⟩⟩; · rwa [show W N le_rfl=p from Nat.decreasingInduction_self ..]
  intro m hm; rw [show W m hm.le=step m hm (W (m+1) hm) from Nat.decreasingInduction_succ_left ..]; exact (passage g (V m hm) _).choose_spec

proof_context.conclusion: Finite (decreasing) induction from the top team builds teams at all levels m <= N linked by Passage.
